title: “固态”“无锂”和“能量密度高”，是三个问题
Solid-state, lithium-free and high specific energy are different questions
principle: 固态描述电解质的物态；锂含量是元素组成；Wh/kg 则是放电能量除以质量。锂金属固态电池仍然可以含锂，所以不能从“固态”推出“无锂”。元素分析、充放电测试与材料物相鉴定各自回答不同问题。

Solid-state describes the electrolyte’s physical form; lithium content is elemental composition; Wh/kg is discharge energy divided by mass. A solid-state lithium-metal cell still contains lithium. Composition analysis, electrical tests and phase identification answer different questions.
example: 读 Intertek 报告时，3.4 ppm w/w 可换算为 0.00034%；但样品来自一个电芯的特定组分。读 VTT 报告时，409.3 Wh/kg 对应 +25 °C、0.1C 放电条件。这两组数据不能互相替代，也不能自动外推到整包和批量产品。

The reported 3.4 ppm w/w converts to 0.00034%, for specified parts of one cell. VTT’s 409.3 Wh/kg refers to +25 °C and 0.1C discharge. These measurements are not interchangeable and do not automatically generalize to packs or production batches.

title: LLZO：传得动离子，还要做得出电池
LLZO: ionic transport is only one manufacturing requirement
principle: LLZO 是石榴石型氧化物固体电解质，常写作 Li₇La₃Zr₂O₁₂。电解质要让 Li⁺ 通过并隔开两极；真实电池还需要与锂金属形成稳定接触。表面污染、接触不足和循环中界面变化会影响电阻与电流分布。

LLZO is a garnet oxide electrolyte, commonly written Li₇La₃Zr₂O₁₂. It must conduct Li⁺ while separating electrodes and maintaining stable contact with lithium. Surface contamination, incomplete contact and evolving interfaces affect resistance and current distribution.
example: 论文中的界面处理即使降低了阻抗，仍没有给出工厂年产量。原市场的 1 GWh/年相当于每年 10⁹ Wh 的电池产出，还必须来自规定的单一设施、指定路线及商业生产证据，不能用实验室一片材料或未来产能规划替代。

An interlayer that lowers laboratory resistance does not measure factory output. The contract’s 1 GWh/year means 10⁹ Wh of annual battery production under its specified facility, chemistry and commercial conditions. A laboratory membrane or announced future capacity cannot establish that threshold.

title: 从隔膜工艺到客户电芯，中间还有产品确认
Separator process, customer cell and product confirmation
principle: QuantumScape 的路线使用固态陶瓷隔膜。制造工艺、QSE-5 样品和 PowerCo 的 Unified Cell 是相互关联但不同的对象：一条中试线设备安装完成，并不能证明特定客户格式的样品已通过合同要求的确认。

QuantumScape uses a solid ceramic separator. Manufacturing processes, QSE-5 samples and PowerCo’s Unified Cell are related but distinct. Installing pilot-line equipment does not by itself establish confirmation of the customer-specific cell format required by a contract.
example: Eagle Line 公告的对象是中试制造与后续放大基础。读这个市场，应另找双方明确提到 Unified Cell 格式、陶瓷隔膜集成与实际样品的原始文件，避免把生产设施进展误认成产品交付。

The Eagle Line announcement concerns pilot manufacturing and a foundation for scale-up. This market instead needs source documents explicitly identifying the Unified Cell format, separator integration and an actual sample, rather than inferring delivery from equipment progress.

title: 整车续航与快充，不能只看电芯的一项数字
Vehicle range and charging are system-level conditions
principle: 续航与可用电量、车辆能耗共同相关；快充时间还取决于起止荷电状态、温度及充电功率。固体电解质路线的突破并不自动给出某一辆量产车的续航，也不能把 10–80% 充电时间读成 0–100%。

Range depends on usable energy and vehicle consumption. Charge duration also depends on starting/ending state of charge, temperature and power. An electrolyte advance does not establish a production vehicle’s range, and a 10–80% charge is not a 0–100% charge.
example: Toyota 的公开路线区分多类液态与固态电池；出光合作聚焦硫化物电解质。判断这个同时含有续航、时间与销售条件的市场，必须让证据落到同一款实际车型，而非从不同项目中各挑一个数字。

Toyota’s roadmap separates liquid and solid electrolytes, while its Idemitsu collaboration focuses on sulfides. Evidence for this combined range/time/sales question must identify the same actual vehicle rather than combine figures from different projects.

title: 手机电池升级，不等于更换电解质路线
An improved phone battery does not establish a new electrolyte
principle: “锂离子”描述离子参与充放电的体系，“固态”描述电解质状态，两者不是互斥的标签。电池更薄、续航更长、充电更快，都不足以单独辨认电解质配方。

Lithium-ion identifies the charge-carrier system; solid-state identifies electrolyte form. The terms are not mutually exclusive. Thickness, endurance and charging speed alone do not identify electrolyte chemistry.
example: Apple 的现行电池说明解释了分阶段充电，却没有把这一点作为固态电池的证据。这个题目需要已发布 iPhone 的明确技术资料或可复核电池分析，不能从供应链传闻或快充宣传直接推出 Yes。

Apple’s battery explanation describes staged charging, not evidence of solid electrolytes. This question needs product-specific technical disclosure or reproducible cell analysis rather than supply-chain rumors or fast-charge marketing.

title: 400 Wh/kg 与“商业可购”，需要两套证据
400 Wh/kg and commercial availability require different evidence
principle: 比能量是放电得到的 Wh 除以质量 kg；体积能量密度则用 Wh/L。电芯、电池包与整车层级不能混用。放电倍率、温度和电压窗口也会影响测得能量。

Specific energy divides discharged Wh by mass in kg; volumetric energy density uses Wh/L. Cell, pack and vehicle measures cannot be interchanged. Rate, temperature and voltage window affect measured discharge energy.
example: VTT 的 DL6 数据提供了单电芯、低倍率下的测量实例。对较早截止的商业发布市场，还要另核对当时能否订购或收货，以及商品是否为同一电芯；后来的实验结果不能改写较早的结算记录。

VTT’s DL6 report illustrates single-cell low-rate measurement. An earlier commercial-release contract additionally needs contemporaneous ordering or delivery evidence for that product. Later measurements do not rewrite the earlier market resolution.

title: 材料发现与无需冷却的商品，是不同终点
A material discovery and an uncooled commercial device are different endpoints
principle: 超导验证需要在约定温度、压力下审查电输运与磁响应，不能只看“电阻降低”或悬浮视频。器件还需要可用电流、磁场范围、机械加工和稳定运行；临界条件一旦超过，材料可能退出超导态。

Evidence must address transport and magnetic response at the specified temperature and pressure, rather than a resistance decrease or levitation video alone. Devices also need usable current/field ranges, processing and stable operation; exceeding critical conditions can destroy superconductivity.
example: DOE 所介绍的超导磁体应用说明超导已有实际用途，但原市场额外要求常压、0 °C 以上和无需主动冷却，既有低温设备不能直接满足它。基础发现题的 No 或短期器件题的 No，也不是“此后永远不可能”的结论。

Existing superconducting magnets demonstrate real applications, but do not satisfy the extra ambient-pressure, above-0 °C and no-active-cooling requirements here. A No on a short-deadline contract is not a claim of permanent impossibility.

title: 复现实验出现，不等于超导结果被复现
A replication paper can appear without replicating superconductivity
principle: 原始宣称、独立实验论文、独立成功复现和商业应用是四类事件。一篇实验论文报告未发现超导，仍可让“有没有独立实验论文”判 Yes，同时让“是否复现成功”判 No。

An original claim, an independent experimental paper, a successful replication and a commercial device are different events. A negative experimental paper can satisfy the paper-appearance contract while failing a superconductivity-replication contract.
example: 曼彻斯特相关实验未在其样品中观察到超导；中国科学院物理所相关工作检验了 Cu₂S 杂相带来的电阻突变。阅读市场时，应核对材料物相、零电阻的测量下限与磁性证据，而不是将一条电阻曲线的形状当作完整验证。

The Manchester-linked study found no superconducting signatures in its samples; the Institute of Physics study examined Cu₂S-related transitions. Market interpretation should track sample phases, resistance limits and magnetic evidence, not just the shape of a resistance curve.

title: AlphaFold、酶催化和空气捕集之间有多道验证
Several validation steps separate AlphaFold, enzymes and direct air capture
principle: 碳酸酐酶可加速 CO₂ 与水、碳酸氢根之间的转化：CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + H⁺。加速反应不等于改变平衡，也不自动给出净捕集量。蛋白结构预测能帮助设计实验，但不能代替催化效率、寿命及再生能耗测量。

Carbonic anhydrase accelerates CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + H⁺. Faster kinetics do not by themselves establish net capture. Structure prediction can guide experiments but does not replace activity, lifetime and regeneration-energy measurements.
example: Sandia 等机构的酶膜研究是真实的分离工作，但不能因此称其使用了 AlphaFold，也不能把烟气条件下的 CO₂ 分离直接等同于从空气净移除。本题还额外要求算法参与及“领先方法”的判定依据。

The enzyme-membrane paper is real separation research, but does not thereby establish AlphaFold use or net atmospheric removal. This contract additionally needs evidence of model involvement and a definition of a leading method.

title: 矿物溶解与净大气碳移除，口径不同
Dissolved mineral and net atmospheric removal are different quantities
principle: 橄榄石风化可向海水提供碱度，使其有能力吸收更多 CO₂。投放多少矿石、溶解多少矿石，以及最终多吸收了多少大气 CO₂，需要分别核算；磨矿、运输与过程排放也影响净值。

Olivine weathering can add alkalinity, increasing seawater’s capacity to absorb CO₂. Deployed mineral, dissolved mineral and additional atmospheric uptake are distinct quantities, with grinding, transport and process emissions affecting net removal.
example: 原题的 10⁹ 吨/年是年度规模门槛，不能用累计投放量或整个海洋增碱领域的理论潜力替代。NOAA 的短期实验提供了化学和生态线索，仍没有建立全球十亿吨级部署或长期安全结论。

The 10⁹-tonne/year threshold is an annual scale, not cumulative mineral deployment or the theoretical potential of all ocean alkalinity methods. NOAA’s short-term work informs chemistry and ecology without establishing gigatonne deployment or long-term safety.

title: 靶增益、净电力与电网供电
Target gain, net electricity and grid supply
principle: 聚变反应放出的能量，需要经过装置能量回收或发电系统才能成为电力。谈“净增益”必须说明计量边界：只计到靶激光，还是计入磁体、驱动、冷却与辅助设施的全部输入。
Fusion energy must be recovered as electricity. A gain claim needs an explicit boundary: target laser energy or all drive, magnet, cooling and auxiliary inputs.
example: NIF 的 3.15 MJ／2.05 MJ 比较针对一次实验的到靶激光，不是整机净电力。Helion 的 50 MW 供电事件则需要发电、并网和客户交付证据，二者不能互相替代。
NIF’s 3.15 MJ/2.05 MJ comparison concerns target laser energy in one shot. Helion’s 50 MW contract needs generation, grid connection and delivery evidence instead.

title: 物理比特、逻辑存储与逻辑运算
Physical qubits, logical memory and logical operations
principle: 逻辑比特由多个物理比特编码，并通过重复测量和解码识别错误。逻辑存储器保持信息，与执行长串通用逻辑门是不同任务；门数也必须说明是物理门还是逻辑门。

Logical qubits encode information across physical qubits using repeated measurement and decoding. Preserving a memory differs from executing long general circuits; gate counts must identify physical or logical operations.
example: Willow 研究通过增大表面码距离观察逻辑错误的抑制。一亿门市场还要求对具备纠错能力的计算机进行公告和第三方验证，不能仅用芯片比特数或随机线路基准替代。

Willow tests logical-error suppression as code distance increases. The 100-million-gate contract additionally requires an announcement and third-party verification, rather than chip size or a random-circuit benchmark.

title: 叠层效率、制造产能与实际出货
Tandem efficiency, factory capacity and shipments
principle: 钙钛矿层与硅层吸收不同波段，以提高入射光的利用率。电池效率经过互联、封装和有效面积损失后，才形成组件效率。制造线的额定能力还要经过良率与利用率，才能转为可销售出货。

Perovskite and silicon absorb different spectral bands. Module efficiency includes interconnection, encapsulation and area losses; nameplate factory capacity becomes sales only through yield and utilization.
example: Oxford PV 首批商业组件的 24.5% 效率说明了产品性能，年度 1 GW 则考查累计交付的额定功率。全球多数部署使用哪种材料，还需要统计整个行业的年度装机。
Oxford PV’s first modules had 24.5% efficiency; annual 1 GW concerns cumulative delivered rated power. A global-majority contract needs industry-wide annual deployment data.

title: 钠离子材料、性能与实际交付
Sodium chemistry, performance and delivery
principle: 载流离子与正负极结构决定电池体系；电芯、整包与车型性能有不同分母。安全测试、技术发布和客户交付分别回答不同的问题。
Charge carriers and electrode structure define the chemistry. Cell, pack and vehicle metrics use different boundaries; safety tests, launches and delivery establish different facts.
example: CATL 公告的 175 Wh/kg 是比能量指标，超过 400 km 是车型续航表述；原题还要求零售客户交车。两者不能替代交付凭证。
CATL’s 175 Wh/kg is a specific-energy claim and over 400 km a vehicle claim. The contract additionally requires customer delivery records.

title: 电池成本与制造边界
Battery costs and manufacturing boundaries
principle: 单位成本必须给出币值、产量、部件和能量分母。单体到整包增加结构、热管理及连接，制造成本也不同于销售与售后更换价格。
Unit costs need currency year, scale, component and energy basis. Packs add structure, cooling and connections; manufacturing cost differs from selling or replacement price.
example: DOE 的 139 美元/kWh 是 2023 年币值、可用能量及规模生产模型。原题讨论 200 英里车型整包不超过 1000 美元，必须核对其实际容量与成本口径。
DOE’s $139/kWh is a constant-2023-dollar, usable-energy production model. The market’s $1,000 pack for a 200-mile vehicle needs its own capacity and cost basis.

title: LFP 材料份额与统计分母
LFP chemistry shares and denominators
principle: LFP 为磷酸铁锂体系，部分行业分类包含 LMFP。生产出货、装车注册与工厂名义能力不同，份额必须在同一范围与年份内计算。
LFP is lithium iron phosphate; some categories include LMFP. Production shipments, registered deployment and nameplate capacity differ; shares need consistent scope and year.
example: IEA 的 2025 年超过 55% 是注册部署容量口径；原题是 2026 年乘用及轻型商用车出货 GWh。不能用前者直接判定后者。
IEA’s over-55% figure uses registered deployment in 2025. The contract uses 2026 passenger/light-commercial shipments in GWh, so the former cannot settle it.

title: 电池储能的 GW 与 GWh
Battery storage in GW and GWh
principle: 电堆或变流器限制功率，电极或电解液总量影响能量。并网储能统计还需区分公用事业级与住宅工商等范围，不能把功率与能量相加。
Stacks and converters limit power while electrode or electrolyte inventory affects energy. Statistics distinguish utility and distributed sectors; power and energy are not additive.
example: EIA 记录的超过 26 GW 是公用事业级功率，市场 260 GWh 则是多部门能量阈值，原题固定的 130 GWh 只作为规则常数显示。
EIA’s over 26 GW measures utility-scale power; the market’s 260 GWh is a multisector energy threshold, with 130 GWh retained solely as a rule constant.

title: 钒价态、电解液与全球消费
Vanadium states, electrolyte and global use
principle: 全钒液流负极和正极分别利用 V(II)/V(III) 与 V(IV)/V(V) 反应。储罐、电堆和泵耗决定系统能力，但行业份额需要钒元素质量统计。
All-vanadium flow uses V(II)/V(III) and V(IV)/V(V) couples. Tanks, stacks and pumping affect systems; market shares require contained-V statistics.
example: 测得电解液浓度和荷电状态可以评估单套系统；判断 2030 年用钒占比至少 20%，还须核对两家独立行业来源与全球消费分母。
Electrolyte measurements characterize a system. The 2030 20% threshold additionally requires two independent industry sources and a global consumption denominator.

title: 凝聚态单体性能与可购买产品
Condensed-cell performance and purchasable products
principle: 比能量为可释放能量与样品质量之比，需给出温度、倍率与样品边界。企业称凝聚态的路线并不自动等于全固态。
Specific energy divides released energy by sample mass and needs temperature, rate and boundary information. A condensed-state label does not automatically imply all-solid-state.
example: 2023 年 500 Wh/kg 公告说明技术发布；原市场同时要求商业来源和 500+ Wh/kg 被证明。本站保留原平台 No，不把公告最高值当作商业验证。
The 2023 500 Wh/kg release is a launch. The contract also requires a commercial source and proven 500+ Wh/kg; its No outcome is retained.

title: 电解装机、氢产量与成本
Electrolysis capacity, hydrogen output and cost
principle: 电解水的产氢与产氧反应由电力驱动。效率、利用小时、电价、设备寿命和系统边界共同决定平准化成本，GW 装机不能单独给出年产量。
Electricity drives hydrogen and oxygen evolution. Efficiency, utilization, price, life and system boundaries determine levelized cost; GW capacity alone does not give annual output.
example: IEA 的 2025 年超过 4 GW 是已安装电解容量；接近 1 Mt 低排放氢包含其他路径。DOE 2031 年目标也不同于原题 2030 年价格条件。
IEA’s over 4 GW is 2025 installed electrolysis; almost 1 Mt low-emissions hydrogen includes other routes. DOE’s 2031 target differs from the market’s 2030 condition.

title: AI 分子设计与临床证据
AI molecular design and clinical evidence
principle: AI 参与需要论文、专利或开发方记录支持。先导化合物、候选药、临床试验与上市批准是不同阶段；主要终点、对照和随访决定试验可回答的问题。
AI contribution needs papers, patents or developer records. Leads, candidates, trials and approval are separate stages; endpoints, controls and follow-up define trial evidence.
example: Rentosertib IIa 期随机入组 71 人并观察 12 周，主要终点为治疗期间不良事件。它既不是全部 AI 药物的验证，也不是 FDA 批准证明。
Rentosertib’s phase 2a randomized 71 people over 12 weeks, with treatment-emergent adverse events primary. It does not validate all AI drugs or establish FDA approval.

title: 永久移除与气候作用
Permanent removal and climate impact
principle: 从空气移除并永久储存 CO₂，需要计入捕集、能源、运输和封存全过程。烟气减排与大气净移除不同，设计产能不能代替核证交付。
Atmospheric removal and durable storage require capture, energy, transport and storage accounting. Avoided flue emissions differ from net removal, and nameplate is not verified delivery.
example: Mammoth 启动公告的 36,000 吨/年为名义能力，不能由此推出全球气候贡献。原题的“关键作用”与未来科学共识需要回到其完整规则。
Mammoth’s startup 36,000 t/year nameplate does not establish global climate impact. The contract’s pivotal-role and consensus language needs its own rule review.

title: 钠离子成本：报价分母与交付层级
Sodium-ion cost: price denominators and product levels
principle: 钠元素资源丰富并不直接决定电芯售价。正负极、集流体、电解液、制造良率和质保都影响成品成本。用美元/kWh 比较时，电芯、模组与整包必须分别注明，能量按题目要求用标称值。

Abundant sodium does not alone set cell prices. Electrodes, collectors, electrolyte, yield and warranty contribute. State cell/module/pack level and use the contract’s nominal-energy denominator for $/kWh.
example: 一件 1 kWh 产品只有在可下单价格不高于 10 美元且满足规则的存档、汇率和排除条件时才进入本题判定。CATL 2021 年的 160 Wh/kg 是比能量，不是 160 美元/kWh；本题背景中的廉价电池说法不代替厂家价目表。

A 1 kWh product needs a qualifying orderable price no higher than $10, with the required archive, exchange rate and exclusions. CATL’s historical 160 Wh/kg is specific energy, not price; the contract’s background assertion does not replace a manufacturer quotation.

title: 钒供应：元素吨与电解液不是同一数量
Vanadium supply: contained tonnes and electrolyte volume
principle: 钒既用于钢铁合金，也用于液流电池电解液。全球钒产量不能全部视为电池可用材料；进入电解液还涉及纯化、价态配置和供应分配。统计中的 V 元素吨与 V₂O₅ 吨数须按化学组成区分。

Vanadium supplies steel and flow-battery electrolytes. Global output is not all battery-ready: purification, oxidation-state control and allocation intervene. Contained-V tonnes differ from tonnes of V₂O₅.
example: 本题问 2027 年 ≥140,000 吨 V，并给出 USGS 优先、备用来源中位数和 2029 年数据等待期。市场背景的两种 2024 基数不一致，本站保留提示；不把钢铁副产供给直接换算成液流储能 GWh。

The contract asks for ≥140,000 t V in 2027, prioritizes USGS, specifies a fallback median and waits for data through 2029. Its inconsistent 2024 baselines remain flagged; steel co-product output is not converted to flow-storage GWh.

title: 电池级锂份额：矿山、精炼与回收的连接
Battery-grade lithium share: mining, refining and recycling
principle: 电池级锂盐需要满足杂质控制和客户认证。矿山开采地、精炼所在地和原料来源可能不同；同一批锂从矿到盐再到电池不能重复相加。以 LCE 计量也不能直接同锂金属吨数相除。

Battery-grade salts require impurity control and customer qualification. Mining origin, refining location and feedstock origin can differ; material passing through stages must not be counted repeatedly. LCE and contained-lithium tonnes cannot be mixed in a share.
example: 原题标题写 2030 年，细则允许 2030 年或之前任何一年的份额，并将确认期限延至 2031 年 2 月 1 日。核对时须记录年份、美国来源定义、全球分母与回收边界，产能规划不能充当实际合格产出。

The title says 2030, while the body accepts 2030 or an earlier year and confirmation by 1 February 2031. Track year, US sourcing, global denominator and recycling boundaries. Planned capacity is not qualified output.

title: 核能制氢：热源、示范与年产量
Nuclear hydrogen: heat source, demonstration and annual output
principle: 核反应堆可以通过供电或供热参与制氢；低排放属性还受电源、热源和工艺边界影响。连接反应堆与化工设施需要许可、安全隔离和连续运行证据，出口温度只描述供热条件。

Reactors can supply electricity or heat to hydrogen production. Emissions depend on the full process boundary; coupling requires licensing, isolation and sustained operation. Outlet temperature describes heat conditions, not output.
example: HTTR 的 950°C 和 2030 年目标说明高温路线与开发日程。本题另要求每年至少 10,000 吨，并由至少两份独立可靠来源确认，不能只用许可申请或短时首次产氢判 Yes。

HTTR’s reported 950°C and 2030 target describe the route and schedule. This contract additionally requires at least 10,000 t/year and two independent credible confirmations; an application or first short hydrogen run cannot establish Yes.

title: 输氢管线：获批长度与运营长度
Hydrogen pipelines: approved and operating length
principle: 专用输氢需要处理材料相容性、密封、压缩与气体纯度。天然气管线改造后只有完成转换并投入氢气运输服务才计入本题；天然气掺氢和厂内短管不算独立运营网络。

Dedicated hydrogen transport requires material compatibility, sealing, compression and gas purity. Repurposed gas lines count only after conversion and entry into hydrogen service; blending and internal plant piping are excluded.
example: 德国 9,040 km 获批网络超过本题 5,000 km 数值，但获批不等于投运。本题要求 2033 年 1 月 1 日前欧洲指定国家内专用氢管线的实际路线长度 >5,000 km，每个物理管段只计一次。

Germany’s 9,040 km approval exceeds 5,000 numerically but is not operating mileage. The contract requires >5,000 route-km in specified European countries before 1 January 2033, counting each physical segment once.

title: 靶增益：输出能量与净增量
Target gain: output ratio and net increment
principle: 靶增益常用聚变输出除以到靶激光能量；工程净增益还要计入激光、冷却和其他设施耗电。输出为输入的 200% 与净增加 200% 分别对应约 2 倍和 3 倍，不能只按标题里的百分号理解。

Target gain divides fusion output by on-target laser energy; engineering gain includes laser, cooling and other electricity. Output at 200% of input means about 2×, whereas a 200% net increase means about 3×.
example: 本题背景把 2022 年约 150% 和 2023 年约 190% 并列，倾向按输出/到靶输入阅读，但正文没有完整公式。本站标注歧义并保留平台 No；历史能量数据和市场判定分别列出，不把 NIF 结果当作聚变电站已送电。

The background’s roughly 150% and 190% examples suggest output/input, but it supplies no complete formula. The ambiguity is flagged and platform No preserved. Historical energies do not establish grid delivery.

title: 并行双比特门：保真度、串扰与测试对象
Parallel two-qubit gates: fidelity, crosstalk and measurement
principle: 双比特门需要在两个量子比特之间建立纠缠。独立门的最优数值与多对门同时运行时的平均表现不同；串扰、泄漏及状态制备和读出误差会影响测试解释。单比特门的高保真度不能替代双比特门数据。

A two-qubit gate entangles a pair. An isolated best gate differs from averages across concurrent pairs; crosstalk, leakage and state-preparation/readout errors affect interpretation. Single-qubit fidelity cannot substitute for two-qubit data.
example: 2023 年论文的 99.5% 与最多 60 个原子是清晰的实验参照，但本题要求企业团队在 2024 年 2 月前报告至少两组同时运行的双比特门，平均保真度至少 99.9%。正文对专家可信性审查和 SPAM 处理留有裁量，必须连同数字阅读。

The 2023 study’s 99.5% on up to 60 atoms is a useful reference. This contract asks for corporate reporting of at least two simultaneous two-qubit gates at ≥99.9% before February 2024, with discretion around expert credibility and SPAM handling.

title: 药物工具归因：计算结果与上市证据
Drug-tool attribution: computational results and approval
principle: 早期药物工具可能参与靶点选择、分子设计或实验排程。证明工具被使用，与证明它显著改变研发路径，需要不同材料；最后还要对应到具体分子的临床和监管结果。
Early tools may inform target selection, molecular design or experiment planning. Use and material influence require different evidence, followed by molecule-specific clinical and regulatory results.
example: 本题要求 FDA 或 EMA 批准以及来自工具供应商之外的贡献说明，也将公司退出早期发现业务列为即时 No 情形。已有 rentosertib IIa 期结果只是另一条研发实例，不证明 markov.bio 的使用、贡献或上市。

The contract requires FDA/EMA approval and contribution evidence outside the tool vendor; leaving early discovery can trigger immediate No. The separate rentosertib Phase IIa example verifies neither markov.bio involvement nor approval.

title: Sabatier 甲烷化：碳利用与永久移除
Sabatier methanation: utilization and durable removal
principle: Sabatier 反应可写作 CO₂ + 4H₂ → CH₄ + 2H₂O。把空气中的碳变成甲烷可储存电能，但燃烧会使碳回到大气；全生命周期是否减排，还取决于供电、甲烷泄漏与设备运行。
The Sabatier reaction is CO₂ + 4H₂ → CH₄ + 2H₂O. Methane stores energy, but combustion returns carbon to the atmosphere; lifecycle emissions depend on power, leakage and operation.
example: Terraform 2024 年披露的是系统接通、运行与成本主张。本题只接受反应器或完整碳浓缩器的大部件销售/租售合同，不要求当年交付，且明确排除仅卖甲烷的情况；因此示范成功与平台 No 可以同时成立。

Terraform’s 2024 post reports an integrated demonstration and costs. This contract instead needs sales/leasing of the reactor or complete concentrator, allows contracting without delivery, and excludes methane-only sales. A successful demonstration can coexist with platform No.
